005package org.wpilib.hardware.expansionhub;
006
007import static org.wpilib.units.Units.Amps;
008import static org.wpilib.units.Units.Volts;
009import static org.wpilib.util.ErrorMessages.requireNonNullParam;
010
011import org.wpilib.hardware.hal.util.AllocationException;
012import org.wpilib.networktables.BooleanPublisher;
013import org.wpilib.networktables.DoublePublisher;
014import org.wpilib.networktables.DoubleSubscriber;
015import org.wpilib.networktables.IntegerPublisher;
016import org.wpilib.networktables.NetworkTableInstance;
017import org.wpilib.networktables.PubSubOption;
018import org.wpilib.system.SystemServer;
019import org.wpilib.units.measure.Current;
020import org.wpilib.units.measure.Voltage;
021
022/** This class controls a specific motor and encoder hooked up to an ExpansionHub. */
023public class ExpansionHubMotor implements AutoCloseable {
024  /** The direction to follow a leader motor in when using the follow method. */
025  public enum FollowDirection {
026    /** Follow the leader motor in the same direction. */
027    Aligned,
028    /** Follow the leader motor in the opposite direction. */
029    Opposed
030  }
031
032  private static final int PERCENTAGE_MODE = 0;
033  private static final int VOLTAGE_MODE = 1;
034  private static final int POSITION_MODE = 2;
035  private static final int VELOCITY_MODE = 3;
036  private static final int FOLLOWER_MODE = 4;
037
038  /** Neutral mode applied when the motor output is commanded to 0. */
039  public enum NeutralMode {
040    /** Allow the motor to coast when output is zero. */
041    COAST,
042    /** Actively brake the motor when output is zero. */
043    BRAKE
044  }
045
046  private ExpansionHub m_hub;
047  private final int m_channel;
048
049  private final DoubleSubscriber m_encoderSubscriber;
050  private final DoubleSubscriber m_encoderVelocitySubscriber;
051  private final DoubleSubscriber m_currentSubscriber;
052
053  private final DoublePublisher m_setpointPublisher;
054  private final BooleanPublisher m_floatOn0Publisher;
055  private final BooleanPublisher m_enabledPublisher;
056
057  private final IntegerPublisher m_modePublisher;
058
059  private final BooleanPublisher m_reversedPublisher;
060  private final BooleanPublisher m_resetEncoderPublisher;
061
062  private final DoublePublisher m_distancePerCountPublisher;
063
064  private final ExpansionHubVelocityConstants m_velocityPidConstants;
065  private final ExpansionHubPositionConstants m_positionPidConstants;
066
067  /**
068   * Constructs a motor at the requested channel on a specific USB port.
069   *
070   * @param usbId The USB port ID the hub is connected to
071   * @param channel The motor channel
072   */
073  public ExpansionHubMotor(int usbId, int channel) {
074    m_hub = new ExpansionHub(usbId);
075    m_channel = channel;
076
077    if (!m_hub.checkMotorChannel(channel)) {
078      m_hub.close();
079      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Channel " + channel + " out of range");
080    }
081
082    if (!m_hub.checkAndReserveMotor(channel)) {
083      m_hub.close();
084      throw new AllocationException("ExpansionHub Motor already allocated");
085    }
086
087    m_hub.reportUsage("ExHubMotor", channel, "ExHubMotor");
088
089    NetworkTableInstance systemServer = SystemServer.getSystemServer();
090
091    PubSubOption[] options =
092        new PubSubOption[] {
093          PubSubOption.SEND_ALL, PubSubOption.KEEP_DUPLICATES, PubSubOption.periodic(0.005)
094        };
095
096    m_encoderSubscriber =
097        systemServer
098            .getDoubleTopic("/rhsp/" + usbId + "/motor" + channel + "/encoder")
099            .subscribe(0, options);
100    m_encoderVelocitySubscriber =
101        systemServer
102            .getDoubleTopic("/rhsp/" + usbId + "/motor" + channel + "/encoderVelocity")
103            .subscribe(0, options);
104    m_currentSubscriber =
105        systemServer
106            .getDoubleTopic("/rhsp/" + usbId + "/motor" + channel + "/current")
107            .subscribe(0, options);
108
109    m_setpointPublisher =
110        systemServer
111            .getDoubleTopic("/rhsp/" + usbId + "/motor" + channel + "/setpoint")
112            .publish(options);
113
114    m_distancePerCountPublisher =
115        systemServer
116            .getDoubleTopic("/rhsp/" + usbId + "/motor" + channel + "/distancePerCount")
117            .publish(options);
118
119    m_floatOn0Publisher =
120        systemServer
121            .getBooleanTopic("/rhsp/" + usbId + "/motor" + channel + "/floatOn0")
122            .publish(options);
123    m_enabledPublisher =
124        systemServer
125            .getBooleanTopic("/rhsp/" + usbId + "/motor" + channel + "/enabled")
126            .publish(options);
127
128    m_modePublisher =
129        systemServer
130            .getIntegerTopic("/rhsp/" + usbId + "/motor" + channel + "/mode")
131            .publish(options);
132
133    m_reversedPublisher =
134        systemServer
135            .getBooleanTopic("/rhsp/" + usbId + "/motor" + channel + "/reversed")
136            .publish(options);
137
138    m_resetEncoderPublisher =
139        systemServer
140            .getBooleanTopic("/rhsp/" + usbId + "/motor" + channel + "/resetEncoder")
141            .publish(options);
142
143    m_velocityPidConstants = new ExpansionHubVelocityConstants(usbId, channel);
144    m_positionPidConstants = new ExpansionHubPositionConstants(usbId, channel);
145  }
146
147  /** Closes a motor so another instance can be constructed. */
148  @Override
149  public void close() {
150    m_hub.unreserveMotor(m_channel);
151    m_hub.close();
152    m_hub = null;
153
154    m_encoderSubscriber.close();
155    m_encoderVelocitySubscriber.close();
156    m_currentSubscriber.close();
157    m_setpointPublisher.close();
158    m_floatOn0Publisher.close();
159    m_enabledPublisher.close();
160    m_modePublisher.close();
161    m_reversedPublisher.close();
162    m_resetEncoderPublisher.close();
163    m_distancePerCountPublisher.close();
164
165    m_velocityPidConstants.close();
166    m_positionPidConstants.close();
167  }
168
169  /**
170   * Sets the throttle.
171   *
172   * @param throttle The throttle where -1 represents full reverse and 1 represents full forward.
173   */
174  public void setThrottle(double throttle) {
175    setEnabled(true);
176    m_modePublisher.set(PERCENTAGE_MODE);
177    m_setpointPublisher.set(throttle);
178  }
179
180  /**
181   * Sets the voltage to run the motor at. This value will be continuously scaled to match the input
182   * voltage.
183   *
184   * @param voltage The voltage to drive the motor at
185   */
186  public void setVoltage(Voltage voltage) {
187    setEnabled(true);
188    m_modePublisher.set(VOLTAGE_MODE);
189    m_setpointPublisher.set(voltage.in(Volts));
190  }
191
192  /**
193   * Command the motor to drive to a specific position setpoint. This value will be scaled by
194   * setDistancePerCount and influenced by the PID constants.
195   *
196   * @param setpoint The position setpoint to drive the motor to
197   */
198  public void setPositionSetpoint(double setpoint) {
199    setEnabled(true);
200    m_modePublisher.set(POSITION_MODE);
201    m_setpointPublisher.set(setpoint);
202  }
203
204  /**
205   * Command the motor to drive to a specific velocity setpoint. This value will be scaled by
206   * setDistancePerCount and influenced by the PID constants.
207   *
208   * @param setpoint The velocity setpoint to drive the motor to
209   */
210  public void setVelocitySetpoint(double setpoint) {
211    setEnabled(true);
212    m_modePublisher.set(VELOCITY_MODE);
213    m_setpointPublisher.set(setpoint);
214  }
215
216  /**
217   * Sets if the motor output is enabled or not. Defaults to false.
218   *
219   * @param enabled True to enable, false to disable
220   */
221  public void setEnabled(boolean enabled) {
222    m_enabledPublisher.set(enabled);
223  }
224
225  /**
226   * Sets if the motor should brake or coast when 0 is commanded. Defaults to BRAKE mode.
227   *
228   * @param mode Neutral mode to apply when output is zero.
229   */
230  public void setNeutralMode(NeutralMode mode) {
231    requireNonNullParam(mode, "mode", "setNeutralMode");
232    m_floatOn0Publisher.set(mode == NeutralMode.COAST);
233  }
234
235  /**
236   * Gets the current being pulled by the motor.
237   *
238   * @return Motor current
239   */
240  public Current getCurrent() {
241    return Amps.of(m_currentSubscriber.get(0));
242  }
243
244  /**
245   * Sets the distance per count of the encoder. Used to scale encoder readings.
246   *
247   * @param perCount The distance moved per count of the encoder
248   */
249  public void setDistancePerCount(double perCount) {
250    m_distancePerCountPublisher.set(perCount);
251  }
252
253  /**
254   * Gets if the underlying ExpansionHub is connected.
255   *
256   * @return True if hub is connected, otherwise false
257   */
258  public boolean isHubConnected() {
259    return m_hub.isHubConnected();
260  }
261
262  /**
263   * Gets the current velocity of the motor encoder. Scaled into distancePerCount units.
264   *
265   * @return Encoder velocity
266   */
267  public double getEncoderVelocity() {
268    return m_encoderVelocitySubscriber.get(0);
269  }
270
271  /**
272   * Gets the current position of the motor encoder. Scaled into distancePerCount units.
273   *
274   * @return Encoder position
275   */
276  public double getEncoderPosition() {
277    return m_encoderSubscriber.get(0);
278  }
279
280  /**
281   * Sets if the motor and encoder should be reversed.
282   *
283   * @param reversed True to reverse encoder, false otherwise
284   */
285  public void setReversed(boolean reversed) {
286    m_reversedPublisher.set(reversed);
287  }
288
289  /** Reset the encoder count to 0. */
290  public void resetEncoder() {
291    m_resetEncoderPublisher.set(true);
292  }
293
294  /**
295   * Gets the motor constants object for velocity PID.
296   *
297   * @return Velocity motor constants object
298   */
299  public ExpansionHubVelocityConstants getVelocityConstants() {
300    return m_velocityPidConstants;
301  }
302
303  /**
304   * Gets the motor constants object for position PID.
305   *
306   * @return Position motor constants object
307   */
308  public ExpansionHubPositionConstants getPositionConstants() {
309    return m_positionPidConstants;
310  }
311
312  /**
313   * Sets this motor to follow another motor on the same hub.
314   *
315   * <p>This does not support following motors that are also followers. Additionally, the direction
316   * of both motors will be the same.
317   *
318   * @param leader The motor to follow
319   * @param direction The direction to follow the leader
320   */
321  public void follow(ExpansionHubMotor leader, FollowDirection direction) {
322    requireNonNullParam(leader, "leader", "follow");
323    if (leader.m_hub.getUsbId() != this.m_hub.getUsbId()) {
324      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Leader motor must be on the same hub as the follower");
325    }
326    if (leader.m_channel == this.m_channel) {
327      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cannot follow self");
328    }
329    m_hub.addFollower(leader.m_channel, this.m_channel);
330    setEnabled(true);
331    m_modePublisher.set(FOLLOWER_MODE);
332    if (direction == FollowDirection.Opposed) {
333      m_setpointPublisher.set(leader.m_channel + 4);
334    } else {
335      m_setpointPublisher.set(leader.m_channel);
336    }
337  }
338
339  /** Stops following the currently set leader motor. */
340  public void unfollow() {
341    m_hub.removeFollower(this.m_channel);
342    setEnabled(false);
343    m_modePublisher.set(PERCENTAGE_MODE);
344    m_setpointPublisher.set(0);
345  }
346}
